page.content:
Best of the Achaeans, whose wrath is the Iliad's subject.

How Achilles connects

  • Event: Trojan War — Achilles' wrath is the central action of the war in the Iliad.
  • Character: Hephaestus — Hephaestus forges the shield and armor Achilles wears back to battle.

What is Achilles?

Achilles, son of Thetis, withdraws from battle over Briseis, returns to kill Hector, and dies before Troy falls — the mortal peak of the Trojan cycle.

Key threads lead to Trojan War and Hephaestus.
